generator_name: Journey to the West Story Generator
based_on: The 'Cause-Effect · Artifact · Obsession' narrative card system
generating_rules: Draw 1 card from the Karma deck · as the story’s scene starting point (K01–K12)
Draw 1 card from the Artifact deck · as the story’s core prop (F01–F10)
Draw 1 card from the Obsession deck · as the story’s psychological theme (Z01–Z10)
The three-card combination determines the story’s ”opening / prop / theme” · the player improvises what follows
The same combination can be performed many times · different players generate completely different stories · this is the very meaning of a ”generator”
generator_features: Repeatability · 1200 combinations can be performed endlessly · each time yielding a different result
Openness · the three cards set only the opening · the rest is the player’s free play
Thematic depth · each Obsession card carries its own theme · stories naturally gain ”enlightenment” depth
Extensibility · new decks (character cards / scene cards) can be added for endless expansion

story_categories.Catastrophe: K02 Mistaken Entry into a Demon Lair + K07 Lost in the Wheel of Rebirth + K10 A Heavenly Tribulation Descends
story_categories.Master-Disciple Conflict: K01 Cast Out of the Monastery + K05 Falsely Implicated + K12 True and False Hard to Tell
story_categories.Enlightenment: K09 Enlightenment in a Dream + K03 An Old Acquaintance Reappears + K08 Return to a Familiar Place
story_categories.Temptation: K04 Forbidden Fruit Eaten by Mistake + K06 A Heaven-Bestowed Task + K11 The Contract Turns Back

design_innovation: A story generator · not a retelling
